source_policy_updates: ShareTextures remains MANUAL_ONLY_NO_AUTOMATION because site terms prohibit automated/bulk downloading.
Freesound remains per-item/authenticated/manual for originals; do not treat its free API as a blanket production-ingest lane.
Poly Haven and ambientCG remain preferred automatic CC0 anchors for materials/HDRIs/selected models.
Sonniss GDC is a high-value manual audio lane; preserve bundle/license provenance and do not load the whole library at runtime.
Fab and mixed marketplaces remain per-item licensed/manual; current listing/version compatibility must be checked before UE4.27 intake.
LOTR-specific fan assets stay reference/quarantine unless rights are independently clear.
execution_order: Run source/warehouse research and indexing in parallel only.
Prioritize gaps that unlock multiple regions: animation, creatures, realistic architecture, audio, VFX, vegetation.
Reuse existing warehouse payloads before any new acquisition.
No download or candidate count may be interpreted as runtime integration or visual acceptance.
evidence_boundary: Research/source governance only. No READY_FOR_IMPORT, runtime integration, PIE, device, visual, pacing or performance acceptance is created by this audit.
